messages.content: ram shyam bhanda aglo chha, shyam hari bhanda aglo. sabai bhanda hocho ko?

messages.steps: ram > shyam ra shyam > hari. tyasaile ram > shyam > hari. hari sabai bhanda tala.

messages.content: sunita anju bhanda jethi, anju bina bhanda kanchhi, ra bina sunita bhanda kanchhi. jethi dekhi kanchhi samma kram milau

messages.steps: sunita > anju. bina > anju (anju bina bhanda kanchhi). sunita > bina. tyasaile sunita sabai bhanda jethi, ani bina, ani anju.

messages.content: A is heavier than B. C is lighter than B. D is heavier than A. Who is the lightest?

messages.steps: D > A > B, and B > C. So the order is D, A, B, C, and C is lightest.

messages.content: 5 jana line ma: kiran bich ma chha, mohan sabai bhanda agadi, nisha kiran ko thik pachhadi, ravi last ma. baki prabin kaha?

messages.steps: 5 thau. mohan 1. kiran bich ma, arthat 3. nisha kiran ko pachhadi, 4. ravi 5. khali rahyo 2, tyasaile prabin 2 ma.

messages.content: race ma bikash le suresh lai jityo, suresh le amit lai, ra deepa bikash bhanda agadi aai. first ko?

messages.steps: deepa > bikash > suresh > amit. sabai bhanda agadi deepa.
kram: 1 deepa, 2 bikash, 3 suresh, 4 amit.

messages.content: 0.5 ra 0.45 ma kun thulo? mero sathi bhanchha 0.45 thulo kinaki 45 > 5
0.5 thulo ho; sathi ko tarika milena.
messages.steps: dasamlab ma ankh ko sankhya haina, sthan herne. 0.5 = 0.50. 0.50 ra 0.45 tulana: 50 saayau > 45 saayau. tyasaile 0.5 > 0.45.

messages.content: 1 kg kapas ra 1 kg falam ma kun gahrungo?
duitai barabar gahrungo chhan, dubai 1 kg. falam saano thau ma hunchha, tyasaile gahrungo jasto lagchha, tara taul ma farak chhaina.

messages.steps: 3 ghanta = 3 x 60 = 180 minet. 200 > 180, farak 20 minet.

messages.content: aaja sombar ho bhane 10 din pachhi kun bar?

messages.steps: 7 din pachhi feri sombar. 10 - 7 = 3 din thap: mangalbar, budhabar, bihibar.

messages.content: parsi aaitabar ho bhane hijo kun bar thiyo?

messages.steps: parsi = aaja + 2 din. aaitabar bata 2 din pachhadi: shanibar, shukrabar. tyasaile aaja shukrabar. hijo = shukrabar bhanda ek din agadi = bihibar.

messages.content: aaja budhabar, 100 din pachhi kun bar hola?

messages.steps: 100 / 7 = 14 hapta baki 2 din. budhabar + 2 = shukrabar.

messages.content: If today is Saturday, what day was it 15 days ago?

messages.steps: 15 = 14 + 1. Going back 14 days lands on Saturday again, then 1 more day back is Friday.

messages.content: march 28 bata 7 din pachhi kati tarik? (march ma 31 din hunchha)

messages.steps: march 28 + 3 = march 31. baki 7 - 3 = 4 din, april 4.

messages.content: mero janmadin baisakh 12 ma ho ra mero sathi ko baisakh 30 ma. kati din farak?
dui janmadin bich 18 din farak chha.
2024 feb ma kati din thiyo? leap year ho?
2024 leap year thiyo, february ma 29 din thiyo.
messages.steps: leap year: 4 le bhag lagne barsha (100 le lagne bhaye 400 le pani lagnu parne). 2024 / 4 = 506, 100 le lagdaina, tyasaile leap year.

messages.content: aaja mangalbar ho. mero exam 9 din pachhi chha. kun bar parchha?

messages.steps: 9 = 7 + 2. mangalbar + 2 = bihibar.

messages.content: result exam ko 3 hapta pachhi aauchha re, tyo kun bar?

messages.steps: 3 hapta = 21 din, jun 7 ko gunan ho, tyasaile bar badaldaina.
har palta 3 le gunieko chha: 2 x 3 = 6, 6 x 3 = 18, 18 x 3 = 54, 54 x 3 = 162.
yi varga sankhya hun: 1x1, 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5. arko 6 x 6 = 36.
farak: 2, 4, 6, 8, har palta 2 le badhchha. arko farak 10. 23 + 10 = 33.

messages.content: A, C, F, J, O, ... arko akshar?

messages.steps: kram sankhya: A=1, C=3, F=6, J=10, O=15. farak 2, 3, 4, 5. arko farak 6: 15 + 6 = 21 = U.

messages.content: arko 13 ho; yo fibonacci series ho.
messages.steps: har sankhya agadi ka dui sankhya ko jod ho: 5 + 8 = 13.
Each step goes back 2 letters: Z (26), X (24), V (22), T (20), so next is 18 = R.
har palta 9 ghatchha: 73 - 9 = 64.

messages.content: yo kram ma pahilo negative sankhya kun aauchha?
odd one out: aanp, kera, suntala, aalu, angur

messages.steps: aanp, kera, suntala ra angur fal hun, aalu tarkari ho (jamin muni falne kanda).
2, 3, 5 ra 11 prime sankhya hun. 9 = 3 x 3, prime haina.

messages.content: which one does not belong: koshi, gandaki, karnali, fewa, mahakali

messages.steps: Koshi, Gandaki, Karnali and Mahakali are rivers of Nepal; Fewa is a lake in Pokhara.
16 = 4x4, 25 = 5x5, 36 = 6x6, 64 = 8x8, sabai varga sankhya. 48 varga haina (6x6 = 36, 7x7 = 49).

messages.content: kalam, pencil, eraser, kitab, chappal - kun milena?

messages.steps: kalam, pencil, eraser ra kitab padhai ka saamagri hun, chappal lagaune chij ho.

messages.content: sabai biralo janawar hun. tom biralo ho. tom janawar ho?

messages.steps: sabai biralo janawar bhitra parchhan. tom biralo, tyasaile tom janawar.

messages.content: sabai chara ura sakchhan? penguin chara ho tara urdaina, haina?
ho, tapai sahi hunuhunchha. penguin chara ho tara urna sakdaina. tyasaile 'sabai chara urchhan' bhanne kura galat ho. dherai chara urchhan, sabai haina; shutarmurg (ostrich) pani urdaina.
kehi bidyarthi khelaadi hun. sabai khelaadi bihana uthchhan. ke sabai bidyarthi bihana uthchhan?

messages.steps: khelaadi bidyarthi haru bihana uthchhan, tara ti 'kehi' matra hun. khelaadi nabhayeka bidyarthi ko barema kei bhaneko chhaina, tyasaile sabai bidyarthi uthchhan bhanna mildaina.

messages.content: yedi pani paryo bhane maidan bhijchha. maidan bhijeko chha. tyasaile pani paryo?

messages.steps: 'pani paryo bhane bhijchha' bhaneko 'bhijyo bhane pani paryo' haina. maidan aru karan le pani bhijna sakchha, jastai kasaile pipe le pani halyo. ulto taraf ko tark galat hunchha.

messages.content: If it is a holiday, the shop is closed. The shop is open today. Is today a holiday?
No, today is not a holiday.
messages.steps: Holiday means closed. The shop is open, so it is not closed, so it cannot be a holiday. (This is valid: if A then B, not B, so not A.)

messages.content: mobile ma battery 0 bhayo bhane switch off hunchha. mero phone switch on chha. battery 0 chha?

messages.steps: 0 bhaye off hunthyo. phone on chha, tyasaile 0 hunna.

messages.content: teen dabba chhan: rato, nilo, hariyo. bal rato ma chhaina. nilo ma pani chhaina. bal kun ma?

messages.steps: tin dabba madhye rato ra nilo hatayo, bachyo hariyo.

messages.content: sorry galat bhane, bal nilo ma chha re, rato ma chhaina matra thaha chha. aba?
tyaso bhaye bal nilo dabba ma chha.
messages.steps: naya jankari anusar bal nilo ma chha. rato ma chhaina bhanne kura pani milchha, hariyo ma pani chhaina kinaki euta bal euta dabba ma matra.

messages.content: euta kotha ma 4 kuna chha, har kuna ma euta biralo, har biralo agadi 3 biralo. jamma kati biralo?

messages.steps: har kuna ko biralo le aru 3 lai dekhchha. tyo 3 nai baki kuna ka biralo hun, naya haina. tyasaile 4.

messages.content: mero buwa ko ek matra chhora ko chhora mero k parchha?
tyo tapai ko afnai chhora ho.
messages.steps: buwa ko ek matra chhora bhaneko tapai nai (yedi tapai chhora hunuhunchha bhane). tapai ko chhora = tapai ko chhora.

messages.content: ghadi ma 3 baje suiharu bich kati degree ko kon hunchha?

messages.steps: ghadi 360 degree, 12 ghanta: 360 / 12 = 30 degree prati ghanta. 3 ghanta: 3 x 30 = 90.

messages.content: euta ladder ma 10 khudkila chhan. ma 3 maathi chadhe, 1 tala jhare, feri 5 maathi. kun khudkila ma chhu? suru tala bata
mero kaksha ma ma agadi bata 8 au ra pachhadi bata 12 au. kaksha ma kati jana?

messages.steps: agadi 7 jana, pachhadi 11 jana, ra tapai 1. 7 + 11 + 1 = 19. ya: 8 + 12 - 1 = 19 (tapai lai dui palta ganiyo).

messages.content: euta snail 10 m kuwa bata din ma 3 m chadhchha, raati 2 m chiplinchha. kati din ma bahira niklanchha?

messages.steps: har pura din ra raat ma 3 - 2 = 1 m. 7 din pachhi 7 m ma. 8 au din 7 + 3 = 10 m pugchha ra niklanchha, feri chiplinna.
